claims.detail: NEW cohort = hired 1 Apr 1998-31 Mar 1999, automatically enrolled: 86% at 3-15 months tenure (as of 30 Jun 1999). claims.detail: Correction published 29 Jun 2026 (epub), issue dated 7 Jul 2026, 123(27), doi 10.1073/pnas.2610441123, PMID 42372171, PMCID PMC13342925. Changes: Table 2 Study 4 has 2 conditions, not 3 (analyzed N = 743, total across 3 conditions = 912); Table 2 Study 6 d = 0.04, not -0.04; Study 6 95% CIs fixed (software error), d values positive, typo in the first t test fixed (1.25, not -1.50); Study 2 N = 408, not 407 (411 recruited, 3 incomplete), Tables S5-S7 updated; Study 4/5 procedure descriptions fixed (7 words not 5; $0.50/$0.30 bonuses; a $0.50 typo shown on Study 5 reporting screen); Kristal is now corresponding author. Editor's note: the authors first contacted PNAS in 2021, posted the correction to COS in 2023 and updated it in May 2026; PNAS apologized for the delay. The notice itself does not say whether conclusions are affected (it only says the editor 'has reviewed and approved these corrections'). Assessment (my inference): the corrected Study 6 effect stays small and non-significant (d = 0.07, 95% CI [-0.04, 0.19]), so the null conclusion (signing first does not reduce dishonesty) is unchanged.
claims.source: Europe PMC full text of PMC13342925 (https://www.ebi.ac.uk/europepmc/webservices/rest/PMC13342925/fullTextXML); metadata https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42372171/. pnas.org and PMC pages blocked the fetch. Note: the reported P = 0.8942 next to t = 1.25 looks internally inconsistent (two-sided p for t = 1.25 is about 0.21); this is as printed in the transcription

claims.detail: Editorial Expression of Concern published 11 Jun 2026, doi 10.1126/science.aej2383 (PubMed 42275523). Issues: inconsistencies in how screening criteria were applied between the manuscript and the published analysis pipeline; the public dataset had extra spliced rows from a code-merging error, which made some reported values hard to reproduce. The authors reported the problems themselves and gave Science a corrected pipeline and updated results, which they say match the original in direction, significance and size. Science is still evaluating. After that: on 27 Sep 2026 the authors posted 'Correction and reproducibility materials' on Zenodo (record 22754984: correction ledger, corrected article and figures). I found no published Science correction, retraction or lifting of the EoC as of 31 Oct 2026. science.org itself could not be fetched, so a recent notice could have been missed.
claims.quote: Science is alerting readers to these issues while this evaluation is underway.
